fabrication_route: rubber-only mould or cast Toyota-style progressive stretch-fit bump-stop; do not copy decayed rubber or cut a block
base_control: Measure left-front bracket landing BL x BW on the vehicle; rubber base footprint clears bracket edges by 0.5-1.0 mm
fastener_control: Measure bolt/stud pitch P and fitted fastener D from the vehicle bracket; release relaxed through-holes or slots in the rubber so it stretches over/around the bolts or studs
contact_face_control: Centre flat rectangular strike face on axle strike pad within +/-5 mm; tapered/radiused progressive rubber body wider at bracket/base face than at strike face; no sharp cuboid
tolerance: height 70 +/-1; rubber base and relaxed hole/slot features +/-0.5 after vehicle release; stretch-fit holes must survive 50 percent compression test
first_article_acceptance: Rubber base seats flat on bracket, bolts/studs pass by stretch-fit hand installation, contacts before shock/tyre/spring/brake-hose hard limit; 50 percent compression test with >=90 percent height recovery after 30 min; no tearing or permanent hole breakout
notes: External references define long-stop height and application. Use reference image/NOS sample for Toyota-style tapered rubber; vehicle bracket and strike pad define rubber base footprint, hole/slot pitch and relaxed size, and contact offset.

fabrication_route: rubber-only mould or cast Toyota-style short right-front progressive stretch-fit bump-stop; do not copy decayed rubber or use long-stop height
base_control: Measure right-front bracket landing BL x BW; rubber base footprint clears bracket edges by 0.5-1.0 mm
fastener_control: Measure right-front bolt/stud pitch P and fitted fastener D from the vehicle bracket; release relaxed through-holes or slots in the rubber so it stretches over/around the bolts or studs
contact_face_control: Centre flat rectangular strike face on right-front axle strike pad within +/-5 mm; keep the shorter tapered right-front geometry; no square block
tolerance: height 60 +/-1; rubber base and relaxed hole/slot features +/-0.5 after vehicle release; do not accept 70 mm aftermarket height here; stretch-fit holes must survive 50 percent compression test
first_article_acceptance: Rubber base seats flat on bracket, bolts/studs pass by stretch-fit hand installation, contacts before shock/tyre/spring/brake-hose hard limit; 50 percent compression test with >=90 percent height recovery after 30 min; no tearing or permanent hole breakout
notes: ToJo warns some aftermarket 48304-60020 stops are wrongly made at the 70 mm long-stop height; reject or trim only by vehicle full-bump release.

fabrication_route: rubber-only mould or cast Toyota-style progressive matched rear stretch-fit bump-stops; do not copy decayed rubber or cut blocks
base_control: Measure each rear bracket landing BL x BW on the vehicle; rubber base footprints clear bracket edges by 0.5-1.0 mm
fastener_control: Measure rear bolt/stud pitch P and fitted fastener D from vehicle brackets; release relaxed through-holes or slots in the rubber so it stretches over/around the bolts or studs
contact_face_control: Centre each flat rectangular strike face on rear axle strike pad within +/-5 mm; matched tapered/radiused left/right profile
tolerance: height 70 +/-1; rear pair free height match <=1; hardness spread <=5 Shore A; rubber base and relaxed hole/slot features +/-0.5 after vehicle release; stretch-fit holes must survive 50 percent compression test
first_article_acceptance: Both rubber bases seat flat on brackets, bolts/studs pass by stretch-fit hand installation, matched pair contacts before shock/tyre/spring/brake-hose hard limit; 50 percent compression test with >=90 percent height recovery after 30 min; no tearing or permanent hole breakout
notes: Use as matched rear rubber pair after final ride height and axle travel checks; no universal, unmatched, or simple cut rear stops.
